task: [.github/workflows/archive-heal.yml] .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml workflow'undaki 68 saniyelik medyan süreyi düşürmek amacıyla, pip ve apt bağımlılık paketlerinin tekrarlı indirilmesini önlemek için 'actions/cache' adımı eklenmeli, ilgisiz kod değişikliklerinde workflow'un gereksiz çalışmasını önlemek için 'paths' filtresi tanımlanmalı ve birbiriyle bağımsız çalışan test adımları ayrı paralel job'lara bölünerek toplam yürütme süresi somut olarak kısaltılmalıdır.

evidence.details: Identified workflow file requiring optimizations: adding actions/cache for pip and apt dependencies, introducing paths filters for push/pull_request triggers, and refactoring sequential test steps into parallel jobs to reduce the current 68-second median duration.

factual_findings: The target workflow file is located at .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml with a baseline median execution duration of 68 seconds.
The existing workflow in .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml re-downloads pip and apt packages on each run due to the absence of dependency caching via actions/cache.
Triggers in .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml lack a 'paths' filter, causing the workflow to run on unrelated documentation or configuration changes.
Independent test steps currently execute sequentially within a single job inside .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml, increasing total wall-clock time.
hypotheses: Adding 'actions/cache' steps for pip wheels and apt package archives in .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml will eliminate repetitive network fetches and speed up environment setup.

Configuring explicit 'paths' and 'paths-ignore' filters on workflow triggers in .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml will prevent execution on non-code changes, reducing overall GitHub Actions billable minutes.
Splitting decoupled test steps into parallel jobs within .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml will significantly reduce the total workflow execution time below the 68-second median.
result.recommendation: Update .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml by adding actions/cache for pip and apt caches, defining 'paths' filters under trigger events, and refactoring independent test steps into separate parallel matrix or multi-job workflows.
result.next_action: Modify .github/workflows/archive-heal.yml to implement path filtering, dependency caching (actions/cache), and parallel job execution, then validate the runtime reduction.
